This sample week illustrates the exercise protocol. It is not a personalized training prescription. Unfamiliar lifts, poor technique, and doing too much too soon can cause injury. If a movement is new to you, get help with your form and adjust the intensity to your ability.

Your weekly workout plan

Tap any exercise name to see three alternatives for your equipment setting. Keep the same set and rep targets or cardio time and intensity. Pick a load you can control for the new movement.

Daily step target · Aim for 8,000–10,000 steps on all seven days, including the rest day.

Training terms
Rep
One complete repetition of an exercise.
Set
A group of reps performed together before resting.
Warm-up set
A lighter practice set that prepares you for the heavier sets.
Working set
A set performed at the weight chosen for your main training effort.
Working weight
The weight used for working sets. Warm-up percentages are based on this weight.
Rest
Time between sets before starting the next one.
Compound exercise
A movement that uses multiple joints, such as a squat.
Isolation exercise
A movement that emphasizes one muscle group, such as a leg extension.

ACE exercise library for form and equipment

Sets and reps for every strength exercise

Pick a working weight you can lift for 6–12 controlled reps. Warm up with the two lighter sets, then complete the two working sets.
